clips.title: The story
paras: Remtravel's Excavation is an archaeological dig site located in the southern reaches of Darkshore. Established by the dwarven Prospector Remtravel, the expedition recently struck ancient subterranean ruins, inadvertently unearthing hostile troggs and stone golems that quickly overran the quarry.

Prospector Remtravel came to Darkshore in search of relics of the distant past, establishing an ambitious dig far from the safety of Auberdine. While excavating ancient strata, his team unearthed a swarm of subterranean Gravelflint troggs alongside hulking stone golems buried beneath the earth. The site was instantly transformed from a scholarly quarry into a hazard zone, scattering the miners and leaving Remtravel scrambling to retrieve his most promising findings.
